info.title: Dashboard API
info.description: When coordinator access is configured, dashboard API operations require a valid coordinator session. Health, documentation and the session endpoint are public. When access is disabled, dashboard operations require no session. Mobile QR sign-in requires individual coordinator accounts. The coordinator cookie authorizes pairing codes and owner operations. Exchange the QR code and a client-generated deviceId for a mobile session bearer. The legacy push-only bearer has its own restricted operations. Set MOBILE_PUSH_ENABLED to enable FCM registration and delivery. Mobile responses specify Cache-Control: no-store.

get.description:
`mode=snapshot` (по умолчанию, API.md): при подключении и при каждой новой ревизии — `event: snapshot` с полным снимком, `id:` = revision.

`mode=notify` (ARCHITECTURE.md): `dashboard.changed` после фиксации изменений, `stream.reset`, если курсор вне журнала. Курсор — `Last-Event-ID`, при первом подключении — `since`.

Каждые `SSE_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS` — комментарий `: heartbeat`.

get.description: В режиме личных учёток учитывает назначения вошедшего координатора. Для общей сессии или открытого режима учитывает назначения всей смены. Начало периода включено, конец исключён. Даты и длительности в ответе представлены миллисекундами. Неизвестная длительность не входит в среднее и KPI. KPI выполнен при длительности строго меньше десяти минут. Интервалы между назначениями команд решения возвращаются в поле reassignmentMs.

post.description: Requires a personal coordinator session. Issuing a code invalidates any earlier unused code for the same account. Display the returned code verbatim as a QR symbol. The code expires after five minutes.

post.summary: Exchange a QR code for a device registration
post.description: Send the scanned code with the client platform and FCM-registered identifier. The server consumes the code and registers the device atomically. A target conflict preserves the code until its original expiry. Save deviceToken from the response in secure client storage. This legacy flow issues a push-management credential. Use POST /mobile/session for account sign-in.

requestBody.description: UTF-8 JSON request body, maximum 8192 bytes.

201.description: Registered device and its management credential.

put.description: Call when Firebase supplies a new FCM registration token or registered installation ID. Send the current identifier and target type together. Repeating the same update is safe. Registered Android and web devices receive dashboard bell signals with data.type set to critical.raised, header.critical, header.waiting or header.deadline. Deduplicate by data.notificationId and open the incident by data.sysId.

requestBody.description: UTF-8 JSON request body, maximum 8192 bytes.

delete.description: The device bearer revokes its own registration and pending deliveries.
Requires the personal coordinator session that owns the device. Use this endpoint to disconnect a lost device.

post.summary: Sign in with a QR code and installation ID
post.description: Works with personal accounts even before FCM is configured. A successful exchange consumes the code and associates the installation with the coordinator who issued it. Repeating sign-in with a fresh code from the same owner rotates the bearer and retains the FCM registration. A failed conflict leaves the code usable until expiry.

requestBody.description: UTF-8 JSON, up to 8192 bytes. The default platform is android.

get.description: Returns all incidents still present in the latest accepted snapshot, including resolved and closed records. No pagination. Each headerKind is computed at serverTime and can change between requests at the same revision. Firebase registration is optional.

post.description: Adds a team_contacted event to the incident history and dashboard event journal. It records the authenticated coordinator and server time. Retry the same team and requestId to retrieve the original event.

provider.description: rules: explainable rules-based analysis. llm: summary and at most one validated team candidate produced in advance by the local model for the current incident fields.

summary.description: Short account of the reported problem, documented actions and current outcome, based on the incident and its recent history. The rules provide this summary while the model is unavailable or still processing. A model-generated summary is identified in the text when the response retains rules-based team candidates.

summaryPending.description: True when a current summary job is queued or running. Clients may refresh the analysis while this flag is true. Absence is equivalent to false.

candidates.description: Teams with evidence from matching completed incidents. For incidents awaiting routing by coordinators, matching incidents in WorkInProgress or Research can supply evidence if no completed case matches. A model abstention in that queue retains evidenced candidates with provider rules.

phone.description: Configured team number or a stable generated example number in international format.

phoneIsTest.description: True for a generated example number. Only configured numbers are intended for dialing.

reassignmentMs.description: Миллисекунды между предыдущим и текущим назначением разных команд решения. null, если дата предыдущего назначения отсутствует или недостоверна либо переход относится к очереди координаторов или технической группе. Показатель строится отдельно от KPI координирования.

authenticated.description: Whether the request has a valid session.

mode.description: Authentication mode selected by the server. Accounts mode requires authentication even before provisioning.

CoordinatorIdentity.description: Present only for an authenticated individual account.

MobilePairingCode.description: Opaque one-time credential. Encode this complete string as the plain text of the QR symbol. The mobile scanner sends that exact text in the code field.

MobileFcmToken.description: Opaque FCM-registered installation ID (FID) or legacy FCM registration token returned by the client Messaging SDK, consisting of visible ASCII characters.

MobilePlatform.description: Use android for a native Android app and web for a browser FCM registration.

expiresAt.description: UTC expiration instant, five minutes after issue.

deviceId.description: Server-generated registration UUID used by the owner to revoke this device. The client supplies its installation ID separately on POST /mobile/session.

deviceToken.description: Store securely on the device. Returned once, this bearer credential permits refreshing its FCM token and unregistering this device.

deviceId.description: Server-generated registration UUID used by the owner to revoke this device. The client supplies its installation ID separately on POST /mobile/session.

pushEnabled.description: True while the server has an FCM registration token for this device.

MobileFcmTargetType.description: Select fid for a Firebase Installation ID reported by the FCM registration callback. The default token target supports clients using the legacy registration token.

MobileClientDeviceId.description: Stable, opaque client-generated installation ID. Send this case-sensitive value and the one-time code when signing in. It is separate from the FCM identifier and the server-generated registration UUID.

TeamContact.description: Details present on team_contacted journal events.

team.description: The displayed assignedGroupName when contact was confirmed.

requestId.description: Generate a UUID for each confirmation and reuse it for retries. It is scoped to the coordinator and incident.

teamPhone.description: Team directory phone when the incident has a matching directory entry.

teamPhoneIsTest.description: True for a generated example number. False when there is a configured phone or no team phone.

deadline.description: UTC timestamp with millisecond precision when present.

lastAssignmentToTeamDateTime.description: UTC timestamp with millisecond precision when present.

headerKind.description: At serverTime, only Assigned, WorkInProgress or Research may qualify. In precedence order: priorityId 4; waiting on the coordinator team for strictly more than 8 minutes since last assignment (fallback submitDate); or strictly less than 20% of the submitDate-to-deadline interval left. The deadline test requires registration at or before serverTime and deadline after registration. At or past deadline it applies only to an unassigned or coordinator-owned incident. Null means no header card.

token.description: Opaque mobile account bearer returned once at sign-in.

MobileDeviceBearer.description: Device token issued by POST /api/v1/mobile/devices. Scoped to updating the registration token and unregistering this device.

MobileSessionBearer.description: Account session token issued by POST /api/v1/mobile/session. Store securely and send in Authorization: Bearer <token>. Valid until logout, owner revocation, account disablement or another successful QR sign-in for this installation. Grants mobile account and registration operations only.

CoordinatorUnauthorized.description: A coordinator session is required or has expired (COORDINATOR_UNAUTHORIZED).

CoordinatorOriginForbidden.description: The browser origin is not permitted (COORDINATOR_ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN).

MobileValidation.description: Malformed JSON, invalid fields or invalid values (VALIDATION_ERROR).

MobileJsonRequired.description: The request requires a JSON Content-Type (UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE).

MobilePairingInvalid.description: The code is unknown, consumed, replaced, expired or belongs to a disabled account (MOBILE_PAIRING_INVALID).

MobileDeviceUnauthorized.description: The device bearer is missing, invalid or revoked, or its account was disabled (MOBILE_DEVICE_UNAUTHORIZED).

MobileFcmTokenInUse.description: Another device already uses this FCM registration identifier (FCM_TOKEN_IN_USE).

MobileDeviceNotFound.description: There is no device with this ID belonging to the authenticated owner (MOBILE_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND).

MobileSessionUnauthorized.description: The mobile account bearer is missing, invalid, revoked or belongs to a disabled account (MOBILE_SESSION_UNAUTHORIZED). Legacy push-management credentials cannot authenticate an account.

MobileDeviceInUse.description: The client installation ID is registered to another account (MOBILE_DEVICE_IN_USE). Its owner or device must unlink it first. The QR code remains valid until its original expiry.
